Four Arrested for Tearing PM Modi's Banners in Bihar

Four individuals have been arrested in Bihar for allegedly tearing down banners and posters advertising an event featuring Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The arrests were made following the incident, though further details on the specific charges or the exact location within Bihar were not provided in the coverage.
